name: Telegram Stremio Addon
description: Stream video, audio, and subtitle files directly from Telegram storage inside Stremio.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API Hash from my.telegram.org

TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID.description: Comma-separated list of target channel IDs (e.g. -1001234567890)

USER_SESSION_STRING.description: Pyrogram string session (highly recommended for >2GB files)

BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token from @BotFather (fallback if USER_SESSION_STRING is not used)

API_KEY.description: Optional key to secure your manifest URL with ?api_key=...

ADDON_URL.description: The URL where this app is deployed (e.g. https://myapp.herokuapp.com)

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Optional Telegram channel ID where play/seek/stop logs are recorded (with region time, date, year and play counts)

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for play logs (e.g. Asia/Kolkata or UTC+05:30, default: UTC)

CONFIG_PASSWORD.description: Password that protects the /configure web setup wizard (set once, then configure everything from the browser)

TMDB_API_KEY.description: Optional TMDB API key for catalog posters, genres and localized titles (falls back to Cinemeta)

TMDB_LANGUAGE.description: Language for TMDB posters/titles, e.g. hi-IN, es-ES (default: en-US)

RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED.description: Enable per-IP rate limiting (true/false). Turn on when sharing the addon publicly

RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.description: API requests per window per IP when rate limiting is on (default: 120)

RATE_LIMIT_STREAM_REQUESTS.description: Media range requests per window per IP (default: 600 - keep high for smooth playback)
